comparison_rules.claim: Exact unchanged Unicode claim strings; no normalization.
comparison_rules.label: Official SUPPORTS/REFUTES mapped to Supported/Refuted.
comparison_rules.pointers: An unordered set of (NFC(page.strip()), integer sentence index) must equal one complete official annotated evidence-group set. Duplicate pointers/order/annotator IDs ignored; no subset or union matching.
comparison_rules.normalization_provenance: Unchanged experiment prepare.py canonical() already uses Unicode NFC and strip. 97 raw set mismatches are encoding-only and are retained in BYTE_EXACT_POINTER_COMPARISON.json.
comparison_rules.limits: Confirms release correspondence of claim texts, labels and selected pointer sets; does not establish factual correctness of annotations or independently authenticate Wikipedia sentence bytes.
